glossary_terms.name: Active Account
glossary_terms.definition: A customer account is considered active if the customer has placed at least one non-cancelled order within the last 90 days. Mapped to `is_active = TRUE` on the `dim_customers` and `stg_customers` tables.

glossary_terms.name: Customer Lifetime Value (LTV)
glossary_terms.definition: The total net revenue attributed to a customer across all their non-cancelled orders. Calculated as SUM(net_amount) from fct_orders or stg_orders where status != 'cancelled'. Exposed as `lifetime_value` column in `dim_customers`.

glossary_terms.name: Net Revenue
glossary_terms.definition: Order revenue after applying discounts. Calculated as amount - discount from raw_orders, stored as net_amount in stg_orders and fct_orders.

glossary_terms.name: PII
glossary_terms.definition: Personally Identifiable Information — data that can be used to identify a specific individual. Columns tagged PII must not be exposed in downstream analytical marts without masking or hashing. In DataHub, PII columns include: email, phone_number, first_name, last_name.

glossary_terms.name: Churn Risk
glossary_terms.definition: A customer is considered at risk of churning if they were active (purchased in last 90 days) but their last_order_date is more than 60 days ago. High churn risk: last_order_date between 60 and 90 days ago.

glossary_terms.name: Order Status
glossary_terms.definition: Normalized order lifecycle state. Valid values: placed (order received, not yet shipped), shipped (order dispatched), delivered (confirmed delivery), cancelled (order voided). Only placed, shipped, delivered orders are counted in revenue metrics.

glossary_terms.name: Product Category
glossary_terms.definition: Top-level grouping for products in the catalog. Current categories: electronics, apparel, home, beauty, sports, books. Used for segment-level revenue reporting.
